Subject: Need help with a maritime salvage claim case

Hello, my name is Gaurav Mukherjee. I am a 31-year-old architect living in Hubballi. Our salvage crew rescued a vessel owned by M/s Malhotra Shipping Pvt Ltd and we claim ₹29.8 crore, and the vessel is about to leave port. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 90001 92733 or email gaurav.mukherjee@example.com.
